decision.instrumentFamily: 12-hole transverse single-chamber Bass C ocarina, STL fingering system
decision.whyBass: STL's Tenor C sounds A4–F6, tonic C5; it cannot sound D4/F4. Its Bass C sounds A3–F5, tonic C4, covering the five existing app pitches.

referencePhysicalProduct.name: Element Ocarina: Shadow in C Major (Bass)
referencePhysicalProduct.dimensionsLimit: Manufacturer gives length only, not a dimensioned CAD drawing, hole diameters, hole coordinates or acoustic cavity dimensions. Do not transfer this dimension to a different Zelda-themed model.

alternativeZeldaBassProduct.name: 12 Hole Bass Ocarina with Zelda Songbook

decision.nomenclature: Use Bass C / Do basse with sounding scientific pitches. Do not infer octaves from the words alto/tenor alone. STL notes that its tenor sounds one octave above written notation; the Bass C chart labels are interpreted together with the manufacturer's stated sounding range.
decision.presentationLimit: The site's 3D ocarina may illustrate this fingering system. It is not a tuned, measured or acoustically calibrated replica. A 5D effect means artistic depth/lighting only, not a claim of five physical dimensions.

holeConvention.halfHoles: None required for these five natural-note fingerings.
holeConvention.soundWindow: The voicing/labium/sound window is not one of the 12 tone holes. Never cover it or count the mouthpiece/windway as a tone hole.
holeConvention.diagramCoordinates: Approximate centers normalized to the enclosing instrument-diagram box of the inspected manufacturer holding page: origin top-left, x rightward, y downward. The two thumb circles are drawn below/outside the outline for explanation; their coordinates are diagram positions, not front-surface model coordinates.
holeConvention.coordinateAccuracy: Rounded visual readings, not manufacturer dimensions and not measurements for mesh drilling. Match hole IDs to the model explicitly; do not blindly map diagram x/y onto a photograph or 3D surface.
holeConvention.handedness: Player's left/right, using the manufacturer's looking-down-at-your-hands tab convention; not a mirrored audience view.
holeConvention.subholeCaution: All requested notes leave both subholes open. Their middle-finger association is derived from adjacency and common operation, not separately labelled in the holding page. No subhole-closing animation is justified by these five mappings.

holes.assignmentBasis: Small auxiliary hole adjacent to the left-middle main-hole area in the manufacturer diagram; all five requested notes leave it open.
holes.fingerAssignmentConfidence: derived from adjacency; the holding diagram does not label the subhole's finger explicitly

holes.assignmentBasis: Small auxiliary hole adjacent to the right-middle main-hole area in the manufacturer diagram; all five requested notes leave it open.
holes.fingerAssignmentConfidence: derived from adjacency; the holding diagram does not label the subhole's finger explicitly

notes.explanationFr: Ré4 : main gauche complète, index/majeur/annulaire droits et les deux pouces fermés ; auriculaire droit et les deux sous-trous ouverts.
Fa4 : main gauche complète, index droit et les deux pouces fermés ; majeur/annulaire/auriculaire droits et les deux sous-trous ouverts.
La4 : index, majeur, auriculaire gauches et les deux pouces fermés ; annulaire gauche, quatre doigts droits et les deux sous-trous ouverts.
Si4 : index et auriculaire gauches, plus les deux pouces fermés ; majeur/annulaire gauches, quatre doigts droits et les deux sous-trous ouverts.
Ré5 : auriculaire gauche et pouce droit fermés ; index/majeur/annulaire gauches, quatre doigts droits, pouce gauche et les deux sous-trous ouverts.
